name: 70438 · Franklinton, LA
findings: ZIP 70438 (Franklinton) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70438 (Franklinton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70438 (Franklinton) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).
